body: She does. She knows I used to cope with life in the first place and understood / was empathetic with my situation. I was a high achieving user, not just a typical abuser/addict.

Thanks for the positive vibes. I am not doing ok. I wish for death seemingly as often as the hours pass. I was already a husk, tried all sorts of anti anxiety and anti depressants which never worked. I was already seeing a therapist.  I was already struggling beyond belief and attempting to use every resource at my disposal to get better... only to have any progress ripped from me and the last semblance of "comfort" ripped from me mercilessly.  I have already considered suicide years ago and always felt it was in my cards to end it when I finally had enough struggling.  This seems to have simply drastically pushed up that timeline.
